title: Phaseo · Telemetry health
description: Check Grafana Cloud Billing / Usage for authoritative ingest volume and quotas. These panels monitor the application pipeline and do not estimate billable bytes.

targets.expr: sum by (service_name) (rate({service_name=~"phaseo-.*"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" [$__auto]))

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Scheduler ticks / 15 minutes
panels.description: Independent of request volume. If absent, check Cloudflare cron and Worker console delivery warnings.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.heartbeat" | __error__="" [15m])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Persistence delivery failures
panels.description: Existing application persistence failures. An OTLP outage cannot reliably report itself through the same OTLP destination.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="telemetry.delivery" | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Attempt batches truncated
panels.description: Provider attempt detail is capped at 16 per request; the request total is still retained.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", attempts_truncated="attempts_truncated" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="gateway.request" | attempts_truncated > 0 | __error__="" [$__auto])) or vector(0)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Collected event types
panels.description: Received events in the selected range. Use this to see which services and event types are actually represented. Counts do not estimate billable bytes or prove uptime.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (service_name, event_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-.*"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent heartbeats
panels.description: Newest 100 scheduler heartbeats. Their arrival confirms scheduler telemetry, not external availability or successful completion of every job.

panels.title: Persistence errors
panels.description: Newest 100 persistence delivery events. Inspect the source and classification. An OTLP outage cannot reliably report itself through the same OTLP destination.
